# Call guide: Larkspur Ceramics, 2026-10-06 10:00

INVENTED TEST FIXTURE: what /ow-start-prep would have written for a fictional client.

## 10:00–10:02 Open
State the goal (understand how orders work today and what has to change) and the next step (a written recap by tomorrow).
Must-ask:
- [trigger] "What made you reach out now, and not six months ago?"
  If vague: "Was there a moment it tipped over? What happened that week?"
- [timeline] "Is there a date this has to work by? What happens if it slips?"
  If vague: "Where does that date come from?"

## 10:02–10:08 Problem and how it works today
Must-ask:
- [current_process] "Walk me through the last time this happened, start to finish."
  If vague: "What was the very first thing someone did? And then?"
- [volume] "How often does this happen, and how many?"
  If vague: "Can you give me a number, even a rough one? Per day or per week?"
- [pain] "What happens when it goes wrong? Who finds out, and how?"
  If vague: "When did that last happen, and what did it cost?"
If time:
- [owners] "Who touches it first? Who's the last person?"

## 10:08–10:13 Systems and constraints
Must-ask:
- [systems] "What tools does this touch today?"
  Confirm: a sample of the order sheet arrives before the call (their email of 2 October).
- [data_condition] "Is the data clean, or does someone fix it by hand? Is anything sensitive in it?"
  If vague: "When did someone last have to correct it, and what was wrong?"
- [regime] "Is there any rule or audit this has to satisfy?"
If time:
- [data_records] "What has to be kept, for how long, and who asks for it?"

## 10:13–10:17 Success and decision
Must-ask:
- [success] "Six months from now it works perfectly. What number changed?"
  If vague: "What would you stop doing, or stop worrying about?"
- [budget] "Is there a budget range set aside, or are we building the case for one?"
  If vague: "Is there a figure above which this needs someone else's sign-off?"
- [decision] "Besides you, who has to say yes, and what would make them say no?"
  If vague: "Who signed off the last thing like this you bought?"
If time:
- [fit_risks] "Have you tried to fix this before? What happened?"

## 10:17–10:20 Read back
- Read back *Today*.
- Read back *What needs to change*.
Must-ask:
- [next_step] "I'll send a written recap by tomorrow. Who else should read it?"
The recap reaches you by Wednesday.
